CustomField.description: Record type applied to Contacts created from this section's related records during conversion. Read in Form_Submission_Convert_Upsert_Contact_Overridable as the section's own value; a blank leaves RecordTypeId unset so Salesforce assigns the converting user's default Contact record type. The section never inherits the Form Template's Contact Record Type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the record type for Contacts this section creates. Leave blank to use the converting user's default Contact record type.
CustomField.label: Contact (Record Type)
